title: 蘭石竹圖（1952.589）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1952.589）
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1662」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Mr. and Mrs. William H. Marlatt Fund

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → qing；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: T'ai Shan Ts'an Shih Lu Ts'ang Hua. Shanghai, 1926.（Reproduced: Portfolio II, pt. 10, pls. 8–13）
Kawai Zenro 河井荃廬. Shina Nanga Taisei 支那南畫大成. 2nd ed. Tōkyō: Kōbunsha, 1937.（Reproduced: Vol. 15, pls. 32 and 33）
Lee, Sherman. "'Rocks, Orchids, and Bamboo' by Shih-T'ao." The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art 41, no. 1 (January 1954): 8, 13–14.（Mentioned: p. 8; Reproduced: pp. 10–11）

Fong, Wen, and Shih-t'ao. “A Letter from Shih-T'ao to Pa-Ta-Shan-Jên and the Problem of Shih-T'ao's Chronology.” Archives of the Chinese Art Society of America, vol. 13, 1959, pp. 22–53.（Mentioned and Reproduced: pp. 34–35, fig. 5）
Chou, Ju-hsi and Anita Chung. Silent poetry: Chinese paintings from the collection of the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, 2015.（Reproduced: pp. 400–407, fig. 1）

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

colophons.text: Title colophon in four characters with signature and two seals on gold-flecked paper.
Artist's signature, inscription (with date of 1662), five seals

The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH

reception.title: Meaning of Nature in Chinese Art

reception.text: 展览史照录自馆方档案，**本库未核对展览图录原件**；仅现行档案（current）部分，馆方标为 legacy 的旧记录未收。
